Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ReleaseFlowResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ReleaseFlowResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReleaseFlowResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable calculation result. Numerical validity never implies engineering qualification.

  • Method Details

    • success

      public static ReleaseFlowResult success(ReleaseFlowModel model, double rate, boolean choked, Map<ReleaseFlowResult.Station,ReleaseState> stations, List<ReleaseFlowResult.Diagnostic> diagnostics, Double soundSpeed, boolean warning)
      Creates a checked successful result for a model implementation.
      Parameters:
      model - model identity
      rate - release rate in kg/s
      choked - true for an interior critical maximum
      stations - resolved station snapshots
      diagnostics - assumption and warning records
      soundSpeed - optional throat equilibrium sound speed in m/s
      warning - whether optional diagnostics failed
      Returns:
      immutable successful result

    • failure

      public static ReleaseFlowResult failure(ReleaseFlowModel model, boolean unsupported, String code, String message)
      Creates an unusable result with no numeric release payload.
      Parameters:
      model - model identity
      unsupported - true when the regime is outside model scope
      code - diagnostic code
      message - diagnostic detail
      Returns:
      immutable failure result
